legalReviewedBy: Codex — factual and technical editorial review
legalReviewScope: Technical and editorial review of ES/EN disclosures for owner-requested native and interaction-initialized popunder advertising. No professional legal advice or Google approval claimed.

advertising.placement: top and bottom on content pages; left and right on initial viewport widths of at least 1920px; legal pages and 404 excluded
advertising.loading: sequential parser-inserted provider scripts in the page document; side slots do not request ads on narrower viewports

native.placement: once at the end of content before the footer; legal pages and 404 excluded
native.loading: asynchronous, directly in the page, data-cfasync=false

popunder.loading: initialized once after a trusted primary click in main editorial content; no automatic popup, synthetic click or navigation cancellation by site code
popunder.exclusions: legal pages, 404, previews, initial consent/settings clicks and clicks inside ad slots
popunder.adsensePolicyConflict: Google prohibits its ads on sites that contain or trigger popunders; remove popunder before using AdSense.

adsense.placement: production content-page head; legal pages and 404 exclude provider script

analytics.placement: all production pages after explicit Analytics consent, including legal pages; excluded from previews

consent.withdrawal: footer preferences; disables collection, clears accessible _ga cookies and reloads
